issues: Built at 480x270 and scaled up: the focus row was about 68px, neighbours 50px grey, and the picker was a thin strip in a big empty grey frame
A flat list with no wheel depth; the focus pill was a thin white strip and hierarchy relied on grey levels alone
The 26x22 AI badge was still a small black chip in the corner after scaling, so it never said who provides these features
Landing on an item gave no reward; apart from the text changing, the five beats looked identical
changes: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt): a fixed left column with a 108px cobalt AI badge, a Juniper kicker and a 90px headline (One assistant. / Every job.); on the right a 980px wheel picker sits inside a faint porcelain glass panel

Now a real wheel: 128px rows, a 78px bold focus row, rows spaced 19 degrees around a cylinder (y = R·sinθ with rotateX), with opacity, size and grey fading continuously by distance and alpha masks at the edges
Rhythm: 0-18f entrance (badge spring, headline lines rising, rows staggered), then five 20f beats of 13f outQuint snap plus 7f true stillness, ending on a 22f hold with a 1% push

Every beat pays off: a 72px cobalt icon tile appears in the focus row, a ⌘N keycap rises at the pill's right end on landing, the pill breathes 1.04 in scaleY, and the left subline swaps to one line about what that feature does for you
The pill is a white capsule with a top highlight and a soft cobalt shadow; the list gets vertical speed blur on fast frames, dropping to zero as it snaps
